hints.title: Extremes Along Path
hints.text: For any node, the maximum absolute difference between it and any ancestor is determined by the minimum and maximum values encountered so far along the path from the root.

hints.title: Top-Down Range Propagation
hints.text: Pass the current minimum and maximum values down the recursive tree calls, updating them with the value of the current node at each step.

hints.title: Leaf Boundary Resolution
hints.text: When reaching a null pointer, return max_val - min_val as the candidate difference for that path. Combine results by taking the maximum across both subtrees.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in the tree
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing every node against all its ancestors naively requires O(N * H) or O(N^2) work.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Carrying running path bounds down during DFS visits each node once in O(N) time with O(H) recursion stack.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that only the running min and max along the ancestor path matter.
complexity.notes: H is O(log N) for balanced trees and O(N) for degenerate trees.
